learning_outcomes.text: Understand applications of perfect fluid (weirs, orifices, jet impact...) by solving Euler and Bernoulli equations.
Understand applications of viscous fluid in pipes in steady flow.
Be able to choose suitable pumps for a water supply network or a pressurized sanitation network.

syllabus_topics: Applications of perfect fluid (weirs, orifices, jet impact…)
Resolution of Euler and Bernoulli equations
Applications of viscous fluid in pipes in steady flow
